thread:
samir: heads up, acme tenant hitting sustained 429s on dedicated pool dp-73 since 09:12 UTC. escalation from their SRE.
elyse: saw the alerts, spikes line up with autoscale churn. do we have a recent quota change for them?
janet: looking now — support panel shows plan change yesterday at 03:00 but quota values look normal (600). filing logs.
mike: 600 what though? the policy UI shows just '600' could be/min or/sec depending on proto. iirc we recently changed unit semantics for dedicated rate profiles.
ryan: omg that might be it. infra deploy last week switched schema to interpret quota.unit as "sec" by default for dedicated. older tenants still sent minute values.
samir: so mismatch => tenants who set 600 (meant/min) are getting 600/sec enforced -> effectively 60x lower allowed burst if downstream expects per-minute. that explains the 429 flood.
janet: grabbing raw enforcement logs for tenant-acme-42 -> snippet: `enforce_rate(tenant=tenant-acme-42,pool=dp-73,limit=600,window=1s) -> 429`
elyse: can you post the tenant's config from billing DB (sanitized)?
janet: `tenant_quota: { rate: "600", unit: "minute", source: legacy_plan_migrate }` — but the enforcement engine parsed unit as "sec" due to missing normalization during plan-migrate path.
mike: reproducer: in staging run curl:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-acme
Body: {"model":"rwd-xl","prompt":"hi"}
# fire 10 reqs/s for 30s
```
If quota is 600/min parsing as sec -> you'll see 429s after ~60 requests.
ryan: opened infra bug #INF-2567 about quota parsing. root cause: plan-migrate job writes string "minute" but enforcement lookup falls back to default enum index 0 => "sec".
samir: immediate mitigation for prod: hotpatch enforcement to accept legacy units for tenants with source=legacy_plan_migrate. can we do a config toggle?
ryan: yes, pushing a guard that maps missing/legacy unit to minute for the migration flag. will deploy to prod pool dp-73 with canary first.
ops-bot: deploy started: infra/guard-quota-legacy->prod (canary dp-73)
elyse: thank you. i've told the customer we've identified root cause and applying hotfix; they asked for ETA on fix and permanent remediation.
mike: remediation: 1) backfill quota normalization job to convert legacy tenant entries to canonical enum, 2) add schema validation on plan-migrate to prevent string units, 3) add an alert when per-tenant enforcement deviates >10x from stored plan value.
janet: backfill script drafted, will run in dry-run against a subset and post results.
ryan: canary passed on dp-73 after 3 minutes, no new 429s. rolling to other dp-*pools now.
ops-bot: deploy successful: infra/guard-quota-legacy->prod (rolled to 5 pools)
samir: confirming with customer — they report traffic normalizing, no further 429s in last 8m.
elyse: follow-ups for postmortem: timeline of plan-migrate changes, list of affected tenants, runbook for quota unit incidents, and adding an e2e test that simulates legacy -> new unit mapping.
mike: logging note: added an enforcement debug field `expected_unit` in logs so we can detect mapping issues quickly.
janet: backing up results and scheduled a sync with billing next week to audit plan-migrate exports.
ryan: INF-2567 PR linked: https://git.internal/r/INF-2567 — contains guard + backfill tool + tests.
samir: closing loop with acme SRE in 15m and then will mark incident resolved. thanks team :thumbsup:
elyse: great job, closing on our side once postmortem draft is ready.
ops-bot: incident annotated: resolved_by=ryan, incident_id=INC-2026-041, severity=high
